n: 1.3 Cu. Ft. Smart Low Profile Over-the-range Microwave Oven
desc: If you like the eye-level access of an over-the-range microwave oven but still want to maintain a sleek kitchen aesthetic, look no further than this LG low-profile microwave which provides maximum interior height to easily fit taller items up to 8 inches in height. The slim design features a Zero Clearance Door for flush installation against any wall or cabinet.
hl: Make cooking easier and decisions faster by selecting from a menu of pre-programmed, automatic cooking settings for tasty meals.
Remove Smoke and Odors with 4-speed, 400 CFM Ventilation
4-Speed ventilation with 400 CFM power helps remove smoke, steam, and odors from your kitchen.2

The slim, unobtrusive design provides a sleek look and a surprisingly roomy interior that offers the most capacity and usable height in its class.¹ So, you can fit taller bowls, mugs, and dishes up to 7.7 inches tall with ease.
Zero Clearance Door for Flush Installation
Thanks to the Zero Clearance Door, the microwave can be installed flush against a wall or cabinet without the need for extra clearance space for the door to swing open.
The intuitive SmoothTouch® glass controls deliver sleek style and easy operation, with just a touch of your finger.
A Smarter Home Starts with the LG ThinQ® App
The ThinQ app offers control and convenience for smart LG appliances to help you simplify life and enjoy the comforts of home.
